ltx2.description: AI video generation using LTX-2.3 22B - text-to-video, image-to-video clips with synchronized audio
ltx2.usage: python tools/ltx2.py --prompt "A sunset over the ocean" --output sunset.mp4

ltx2_local.description: Free local video generation with synchronized audio using LTX-2.5-MLX (Apple Silicon) — no API key, no cloud cost, no Modal dependency
ltx2_local.usage: python tools/ltx25_mlx_adapter.py --prompt "A sunset over the ocean" --output sunset.mp4
ltx2_local.backend: ltx-2-mlx runtime (github.com/MrMoferFRAN/ltx-2-mlx, branch ltx25, pinned commit 57952288) + MrMofer/ltx-2.5-mlx-q8 weights, cached locally in ~/AI-Modelle/ltx-2-mlx and ~/.cache/huggingface/hub

options.--continue-from: Continue a previous clip by extracting its final frame as the next I2V anchor; mutually exclusive with --image
options.--no-low-ram: Disable block streaming (needs ~72GB RAM without it; 24GB Macs require --low-ram, the default)

ltx2_local.verified: Live test generation confirmed working 2026-09-26: 704x448, 97 frames, --distilled --low-ram on M4 Pro 24GB RAM, 190.7s render time. Audio track contains real synchronized speech — MLX Whisper transcribed the target German phrase back out at 94-97% word confidence. Known limitation: camera-facing / "looks into camera" framing instructions are not reliably honored — review output frames before relying on visible lip-sync.

ltx25_layout_to_render.description: Planned local LTX-2.5 IC-LoRA workflow guided by a 3D blocking/reference video for camera, composition, and motion control
ltx25_layout_to_render.status: planned; blocked until local weights, license review, MLX compatibility test, and visual continuity acceptance
activation_gate: Review the exact model license and access terms
Obtain explicit approval before any model download or account authentication
Verify the LoRA loads through the pinned MLX runtime without network fallback
Run a Blender blocking to LTX render test and compare camera path, framing, pose, and timing frame by frame
Keep disabled if geometry or temporal alignment drifts beyond production tolerance
ltx25_layout_to_render.verified: Official LTX VFX capability confirmed; not installed or live-tested in this workspace

ltx25_alpha_gen.description: Planned local LTX-2.5 Alpha Gen IC-LoRA that converts an RGB video into a frame-aligned grayscale alpha matte for compositing

ltx25_alpha_gen.backend: candidate: local ltx-2-mlx IC-LoRA; do not route through the normal MP4 generator

limits.foreground_selection: automatic; no prompt or mask selection
limits.output: grayscale matte; composite separately with the source RGB video

higgsfield_video.description: AI video generation via the installed Higgsfield CLI (cloud, paid) — always shows credit cost + account balance before spending; generation requires --confirm
higgsfield_video.usage: python tools/higgsfield_video.py --prompt "..." --output clip.mp4  # cost preview only; add --confirm to generate
higgsfield_video.requires: higgsfield CLI installed + logged in (already set up)

options.--confirm: Required to actually spend credits and create the job

higgsfield_video.costGating: Shows `higgsfield generate cost` estimate + account balance by default; no job is created without --confirm

chain_video.description: Chain local LTX-2.5-MLX clips with visual continuity; follow-up scenes use the adapter's --continue-from end-frame anchor
chain_video.requires: Local protected LTX-2.5-MLX runtime and weights

transcribe.description: Free local audio/video transcription plus SRT/VTT generation and deterministic subtitle QC using mlx-whisper (Apple Silicon optimized)
transcribe.requires: mlx-whisper; optional FFmpeg subtitles/libass filter for burned subtitles

options.--transcript-json: Existing mlx-whisper-compatible timestamp JSON; creates subtitles without rerunning transcription
options.--subtitle-qc: Run local structure, timing, overlap, duration and line-length QC
options.--burn-in: Optional video input for FFmpeg subtitle burn-in when the local filter is available

video_ingest.description: Safe local ingest and deterministic technical analysis for local media, direct public media URLs and public single-video YouTube/Instagram URLs
video_ingest.requires: ffprobe and FFmpeg; yt-dlp only for public platform URLs; cached local mlx-whisper model only with --transcribe
limitations: No DRM, login, cookie, credential, paywall or access-control bypass
YouTube playlists and channel URLs are rejected
Public platform availability depends on the installed yt-dlp and is separately integration-tested

options.--metadata-only: Validate and write only deterministic technical metadata
options.--transcribe: Run cached local MLX Whisper and write transcript.json
options.--max-frames: Hard maximum count for extracted frames

video_analyze.description: Deterministic local scene, transcript, silence and clip-candidate analysis for an existing ingest package
video_analyze.requires: FFmpeg scene and frame filters; existing ingest package; optional transcript.json and audio stream
limitations: Only measured technical features; semantic_analysis remains not_run
One controlled representative frame is emitted per detected scene
Clip and chapter entries are candidates, not creative or viral rankings

options.--scene-threshold: Local FFmpeg visual scene-change threshold between 0 and 1
options.--min-clip-duration: Minimum deterministic clip-candidate duration in seconds
options.--max-clip-duration: Maximum deterministic clip-candidate duration in seconds

kokoro_tts.description: Free local TTS using Kokoro 82M — best open-source quality, runs on M4 Pro, no API key, no cold start

options.--voice: Voice name (default: am_michael). 28 voices: af_heart, am_michael, bm_george, etc.
options.--list-voices: List all 28 available voices with descriptions

piper_tts.description: Free local German TTS using Piper (Thorsten high-quality voice) — no API key, no cold start

options.--voice: Voice name (default: thorsten). German only for now.

gemini_tts.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash / Flash-Lite TTS (Google, cloud API) — NOT local, NOT free (has a rate-limited free tier; free-tier content is used by Google to improve its products). Noticeably higher quality than Piper: natural prosody, emotional style annotations, 130+ languages.

options.--style: Emotional/delivery style annotation, e.g. 'cheerful and friendly'

gemini_tts.verified: Live test 2026-09-26: German phrase round-tripped through MLX Whisper at 92-99% word confidence. Also wired into tools/voiceover.py as --provider gemini (single-file, dry-run, and scene-dir modes all tested).

subtitle_translate.description: Translate SRT/VTT subtitles. Default engine argos is local, offline, free forever, and requires no account; live-verified de<->en including a network-blocked run. Gemini (cloud, gemini-3.8-flash) is available only by explicit selection. --engine ollama (local, devstral-small-2:latest) is kept only for explicit comparison — NOT reliable, observed echoing the prompt template's placeholder text instead of translating.
subtitle_translate.backend: cloud (gemini-3.8-flash) by default; local Argos Translate via --engine argos (recommended local/free option); local Ollama LLM via --engine ollama (unreliable, comparison only)

options.--engine: gemini (default, cloud, reliable), argos (local, free forever, verified, recommended local option), or ollama (local LLM, unreliable for this task, comparison only)
options.--source-language: Source language, only used by --engine argos (default: de)
options.--model: Override model for the selected engine

subtitle_translate.verified: Live test 2026-09-26: gemini engine correctly translated German test line to English. argos engine live-verified end-to-end with a real SRT file (de->en, correct natural translation, exit 0, four repeated single-direction runs with no crash — a mixed-direction crash at Python interpreter shutdown was observed once but does not affect single-direction runs, which is how this tool always calls it). Ollama engine confirmed broken (placeholder echo + intermittent 60s+ timeout) and now fails loudly with a clear error instead of silently writing wrong subtitles. Language packages installed: de<->en via ~/.local/share/argos-translate/packages/.
